roles.title: Software Developer
roles.description: Designs, codes, tests, and maintains scalable software applications across diverse stacks and domains.
roadmap: Master fundamental data structures and algorithms in Python or Java
Build modular applications using OOP and design patterns
Learn database management with SQL and ORM frameworks
Practice collaborative development using Git, GitHub, and unit testing

roles.title: Java Developer
roles.description: Specializes in enterprise backend architecture, microservices, and distributed systems using Java and Spring Boot.
roadmap: Deepen knowledge in Java 17/21 core concurrency and JVM internals
Build production REST APIs with Spring Boot, Spring Security, and Hibernate
Implement relational caching with Redis and PostgreSQL optimization
Architect and deploy containerized microservices using Docker

roles.title: Backend Developer
roles.description: Builds server-side logic, high-throughput APIs, database architectures, authentication, and cloud services.
roadmap: Master asynchronous runtime execution and event loops in Node.js
Design scalable RESTful and GraphQL APIs with robust validation and JWT auth
Design relational and NoSQL schemas (PostgreSQL, MongoDB) with indexing
Implement caching layers with Redis and containerize services with Docker

roles.title: Frontend Developer
roles.description: Crafts intuitive, responsive, accessible, and performant user interfaces using modern JavaScript/TypeScript and frameworks.
roadmap: Master modern JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, and browser DOM rendering
Build dynamic single-page applications with React (Hooks, Context, State Management)
Create responsive UI layouts using Tailwind CSS and CSS Grid/Flexbox
Optimize Core Web Vitals, SSR with Next.js, and client-side API consumption

roles.title: Full Stack Developer
roles.description: Masters both client-side and server-side engineering, bridging UI components with robust data backends and deployment.
roadmap: Develop full-stack web applications linking React frontends with Express/Node backends
Implement secure authentication, session management, and role-based access control
Manage complex relational databases in PostgreSQL with migrations and ORMs
Containerize full-stack apps with Docker and deploy to cloud environments

roles.title: Data Analyst
roles.description: Transforms raw business datasets into actionable business intelligence through SQL queries, statistical models, and dashboards.
roadmap: Master complex SQL queries, window functions, CTEs, and aggregation
Perform exploratory data analysis and data wrangling using Python (Pandas, NumPy)
Build interactive executive dashboards in Power BI and Tableau
Communicate analytical findings and business metrics effectively to stakeholders

roles.title: Data Scientist
roles.description: Leverages statistical modeling, machine learning, and big data to discover hidden patterns and generate predictive insights.
roadmap: Master mathematical foundations (linear algebra, probability, inferential statistics)
Implement regression, classification, and clustering pipelines with Scikit-Learn
Engineer features, cross-validate models, and evaluate precision/recall tradeoffs
Deploy predictive models via REST APIs and communicate experimental results

roles.title: Machine Learning Engineer
roles.description: Designs, trains, deploys, and optimizes state-of-the-art machine learning, deep learning, and NLP models in production.
roadmap: Build and fine-tune deep neural networks with PyTorch or TensorFlow
Master NLP transformers (BERT, GPT, HuggingFace) and text processing
Package models into scalable low-latency FastAPI inference microservices
Implement MLOps workflows for model versioning, Dockerization, and GPU acceleration

roles.title: DevOps Engineer
roles.description: Automates build, test, and release pipelines, managing container orchestration, cloud infrastructure, and observability.
roadmap: Master Linux administration, networking fundamentals, and shell scripting
Build robust multi-stage Docker images and configure Kubernetes clusters
Implement automated CI/CD release pipelines with GitHub Actions or Jenkins
Provision scalable cloud infrastructure as code using Terraform on AWS/GCP

roles.title: Cloud Engineer
roles.description: Architects, secures, and maintains scalable multi-cloud infrastructure and serverless distributed systems.
roadmap: Attain cloud architectural proficiency (AWS Solutions Architect / Azure Administrator)
Configure VPCs, security groups, IAM policies, load balancers, and auto-scaling
Build serverless event-driven architectures with AWS Lambda / Cloud Functions
Enforce cloud security, compliance, cost optimization, and disaster recovery
